caption: The drawing depicts a sculpture of a nude, male child-like figure seated atop a large, stylized shell with spiral forms at each end. The figure has curly brown hair and is holding a yellow pan flute to his lips with both hands. His body appears to have a cracked, aged surface texture, emphasized by fine dark lines. The shell on which he sits is predominantly blue with turquoise and brownish accents, along with areas of yellow and white that also exhibit a crackled texture. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, leaving all focus on the central sculptural form.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: Pan
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
